features.name: recency_zscore
features.description: Standardized recency (months since last donation) to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the recency feature from dominating or being overshadowed by other features in KNN distance metrics.

features.name: frequency_zscore
features.description: Standardized frequency (total number of donations) to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the frequency scale, improving the geometry of the neighborhood space.

features.name: time_zscore
features.description: Standardized time (months since first donation) to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the time scale, allowing for fair distance comparisons across all dimensions.

features.name: donation_rate
features.description: The average number of donations per month since the first donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized measure of donation intensity, which is highly discriminative for finding similar donor profiles.

features.name: active_period
features.description: The duration in months between the first and last donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the actual span of active donation behavior, helping to group donors with similar longevity.

features.name: log_frequency
features.description: Log-transformed frequency to reduce the impact of extreme outliers in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the long tail of the frequency distribution, making Euclidean distances more robust to extreme values.

features.name: avg_time_between_donations
features.description: The average number of months between donations during the donor's active period.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a scale-invariant measure of donation rhythm, improving similarity matching for donors with different total tenures.

features.name: distance_to_centroid
features.description: Euclidean distance to the global mean of the standardized features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as an anomaly or typicality score, helping KNN distinguish between average and outlier profiles.

features.name: loyalty_ratio
features.description: The ratio of the active donation period to the total time since the first donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the active period by the total tenure, providing a bounded similarity metric for donor retention.

features.name: high_frequency_recent
features.description: Indicator for donors who have above-average frequency and below-average recency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a distinct subspace for highly engaged donors, forcing KNN to group them together.

features.name: donor_profile_cluster
features.description: Assigns a cluster ID (1 to 5) based on the donor's recency, frequency, and time profile, grouping similar donors together.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a categorical grouping that can act as a strong prior for neighborhood formation in distance-based models.

features.name: semantic_similarity_to_ideal_donor
features.description: A semantic similarity score (0 to 1) comparing the donor's profile to a hypothetical ideal donor who donates frequently, has a long history, and donated recently.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects the multi-dimensional donor profile onto a single continuous axis of 'idealness', simplifying the distance space.
